description: Private, verified replay of a Hyperliquid perp trade from the account's own records: what the agent submitted (local journal), what filled, why it closed (order history), fees incl. the GDEX builder fee, funding, net realized P&L, and whether the position is flat and linked TP/SL orders are gone (fresh reads). Missing data is reported as unknown, never guessed. "Replay my last trade" → latest: true. If several trades match without latest/closeId, returns candidates: ask the user which. Read-only: cannot place or cancel anything.

accountRef.description: From gdex_connect; may be omitted when exactly one account is connected

closeId.description: A specific trade from the candidates list

coin.description: Only trades in this market, e.g. ETH or xyz:TSLA

lookbackDays.description: How far back to read fills (default 30)

name: gdex_replay_trade
